behaviors.description: Identify the controlled sandbox's application process and supervising parent.
behaviors.preconditions: DO_NOT_REAP launches held alive until explicit release; public procfs exposes process executable and ancestry.
behaviors.expected: Child PID becomes positive and executable bytes match the deployed probe; process ancestry reaches outer PID; child watch confirms successful exit.

behaviors.description: Launch selected installed builds through libflatpak and enumerate live instances.
behaviors.preconditions: Two controlled probe apps copy their internal flatpak-info and remain alive until the client releases them.
behaviors.expected: Direct launch succeeds twice; both report version A; distinct enumerated IDs, full app/runtime identities and snapshot-matching info while alive.
references: common/flatpak-instance.c: public enumeration and identity getters

behaviors.description: Track launched instances with caller-owned child watches.
behaviors.preconditions: Two DO_NOT_REAP launches return instances; probes hold lifetime until explicit release.
behaviors.expected: Returned instances have exact live identities and info; watches observe successful exit; retained instances then report not running.

behaviors.description: Configure a ref-file remote without deploying its app.
behaviors.preconditions: Initially empty installation and valid literal flatpakref pointing at controlled repository.
behaviors.expected: Returned ref has exact identity and NULL commit; its remote exists at expected URL; installed list remains empty.

behaviors.description: Read real bundle payloads and retain owned results.
behaviors.preconditions: Reference-exported bundles with and without URLs, distinct 64/128 PNGs, compressed XML and metadata.
behaviors.expected: Identity, commit, file, metadata, XML, size, icons and URLs match; owned file, bytes and origin survive bundle destruction.

behaviors.description: Install, update and uninstall through deprecated direct APIs.
behaviors.preconditions: Runtime satisfied; independent repositories A then B.
behaviors.expected: Direct install returns deployed A, direct update returns deployed B, direct uninstall leaves NOT_INSTALLED.

behaviors.description: Distinguish direct no-op and absent updates.
behaviors.preconditions: Current app and a separate absent advertised app.
behaviors.expected: update_full returns NULL with Flatpak ALREADY_INSTALLED or NOT_INSTALLED respectively.

behaviors.description: Pull without deployment, then deploy the pulled ref.
behaviors.preconditions: Runtime satisfied and app initially absent.
behaviors.expected: NO_DEPLOY returns ONLY_PULLED and leaves app absent; NO_PULL returns fixture commit and deploys it.

mappings.rationale: Direct library launches synchronize on two real sandbox probes; independently expected commits and identities, distinct enumeration IDs and every sandbox snapshot key are asserted.
DO_NOT_REAP returns exact fixture instances; explicit probe release, successful child watches and post-exit FALSE liveness checked on retained instances.
Synchronized child PID must identify the deployed probe executable; its ancestry must reach the outer PID; caller child watch confirms exit.
Direct ref-file API returns NULL-commit ref, configures a lookup-visible expected remote URL and leaves installation empty.
Actual bundles assert all payload fields against independent inputs, both optional URL cases and retained transfer-full results after destruction.
All three deprecated functions execute; returned and queried commits match A/B and final lookup yields NOT_INSTALLED.
update_full NULL and exact public domain/code asserted for current and absent fixtures.
NO_DEPLOY exact ONLY_PULLED plus absent deployment, then NO_PULL exact deployed commit.
